name: Maahes
legendaryAbilityText: At the start of a tactical action, you may exhaust this card to place 1 frontier token into up to 3 fracture systems that do not contain any planets or frontier tokens.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: It moves and breathes like us, but it's more like they are imitating life rather than living.
flavorText: *A jagged world of churning magma and sprawling automated forges. Its surfaces constantly tears open from gravitational stress, bleeding raw energy to fuel the empire's war machines.*
